name: All fifty-four original and new milestones have unique metadata and local vector badges
Every newly represented evolution class has an exact attained-stage threshold
Evolution queues its milestone without covering the cinematic or interrupting flight
One-journey capture milestones ignore totals from older journeys
A physically stable star, planet and moon hierarchy earns World with Company
Six real stable small bodies form a belt and unlock its milestone
Orbital resonance must be actually established rather than a short-lived period estimate
Final companion specialization unlocks Growing Together through the existing branch action
Six finite discoveries earn Field Notes while five do not
Six class goals earn Pathfinder without awarding additional resources or adaptation points
A last-second capture milestone is retained at game over
Rapid real unlocks queue once, in order, without using the ordinary alert stack
Task, goal and challenge plaques use one DOM element and play their cue at display time
Menus, evolution, photo mode and hidden HUD defer queued plaques
An already visible plaque pauses its clock while a menu or HUD hiding obscures it
Notification opt-out retains achievements and adds no popup or chime
Top and bottom placement work from the very first displayed frame
Advancement menu has all six complete branches, exact earned counts and earned filtering
Search examines all branches and safely handles arbitrary typed text
Selection displays real progress and related links do not gate earning
Records and journey log remain available alongside the advancement map
J toggles the advancement window without becoming a movement input
Checkpoint and full load preserve new unlocks and notification settings in the original slot
Old profile migration reconciles only attained new classes without a burst of fake notifications
Repeated restarts clear active and pending plaques without new listeners or animation loops
Sandbox keeps its milestone queue and normal-slot achievement collection untouched
Arrow navigation focuses another real node and updates selection without an unlock
All three plaque chimes synthesize in the single procedural context and obey mute
